text: Several visitors expressed frustration with the timed ticketing system, noting a lack of flexibility and difficulty accommodating changes or late arrivals. Some found the cost high, especially for families, and felt the museum was crowded at peak times. There were repeated criticisms about the use of AI in the exhibits, with some reviewers saying it detracted from learning about Theodore Roosevelt. A few comments mentioned limited staff availability for customer support. Positive remarks focused on the building’s architecture and interactive exhibits, but concerns about crowding and interpretation remain.
